_comment: Customer-support intents of a fictitious online shop. Each intent lists paraphrases that deserve the SAME answer. Intents sharing a 'group' are confusable on purpose (same words, different answer): they are the hard negatives. 'split' separates calibration (dev) from reporting (test); a whole group is always in the same split, so every confusable pair is scored.
